item.title: World Surf League Adds Raglan, New Zealand as Fourth Stop on 2026 Championship Tour
item.description: The World Surf League replaced Jeffreys Bay in South Africa with New Zealand's most famous wave: the beautiful left at Raglan on the North Island's west coast.

item.title: Surf Writer Matt George and Blink-182’s Tom DeLonge Are Making a Film
item.description: Blink-182 frontman Tom DeLonge and former pro surfer and surf writer Matt George are working together on a new surf-based feature film.

item.title: Gearoid McDaid Scores Thick Tubes at a Fickle Home Break
item.description: Gearoid McDaid told us this wave can be so fickle it only breaks for a proper 30 minutes, sometimes just before the tide turns everything off.

item.title: 12-Year-Old Shark Australian Attack Victim Nico Antic Has Passed Away
item.description: In an update from his parents, Nico Antic has tragically succumbed to the wounds he suffered when a shark attacked him while he was swimming in Sydney Harbor.

item.title: Marineland Is Threatening to Kill 30 Beluga Whales and 4 Dolphins Again
item.description: Marineland, the shuttered amusement park in Ontario, Canada, reissued threats to euthanize 30 beluga whales and four dolphins after the park closed.

item.title: Carlos Gauna Explains Exactly How He Finds Great White Sharks With His Drone
item.description: Carlos Gauna has spent many hours searching for great white sharks off L.A., and in his most recent video, he explains how he goes about finding them.

item.title: Shaun White Had an Impromptu Session in Central Park
item.description: Olympic snowboarder Shaun White put on a show for New Yorkers Sunday as Central Park received a record 11.4 inches of fresh snow.

item.title: Wild Video Shows Skier Being Attacked by Snow Leopard in China
item.description: In wild video, a skier near a resort in the Keketuohai Unesco Global Geopark, in northwest China is shown being mauled by a snow leopard.

item.title: Silvana Lima On Sponsor Rejections Because of Sexuality and How the Olympics Saved Her
item.description: Surfer Silvana Lima discusses her time on the WSL Championship Tour, how sponsors rejected her because of sexual preference, and how the Olympics saved her.

item.title: Lost Hikers Stick Mountain Rescuers With Hotel Bill After Safe Return
item.description: A pair of lost hikers rewarded their rescuers' efforts by sticking them with a hotel bill and making off with two headlamps lent to them during the operation.
